Embassy of Montenegro in United Kingdom
Visa regime
Citizens of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland, as well as holders of valid travel documents issued in the British Overseas Territories: Anguilla, Bermuda, the British Antarctic Territory, the British Indian Ocean Territory, the British Virgin Islands, the Cayman Islands, the Falkland Islands, Gibraltar, Montserrat, Pitcairn Island, Saint Helena, Ascension Island, and Tristan da Cunha, South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands, and the Turks and Caicos Islands may enter, transit through, and stay in Montenegro for up to 90 days, with a valid travel document, without a visa.
Diplomatic relations
The United Kingdom recognized Montenegro's independence and diplomatic relations were established between the two countries on 13 June 2006.
Until the appointment of the ambassador, the Embassy of Montenegro in the United Kingdom currently operates at the level of Chargé d'Affaires a.i.
The Ambassador of the United Kingdom to Montenegro is Dawn McKen.
